name: Kashmir to Ladakh trip
route: Srinagar → Kargil → Leh → Nubra Valley → Pangong Lake → Leh
description: Discover the unmatched beauty of Kashmir and Ladakh through this thoughtfully designed 8-day journey. From the serene gardens and lakes of Srinagar to the rugged landscapes of Kargil and the high-altitude wonders of Leh, Nubra Valley, and Pangong Lake—this trip offers a perfect blend of nature, adventure, and culture. Experience scenic drives across mountain passes, explore ancient monasteries, and enjoy unique stays, including houseboats and camps. This tour is ideal for travelers seeking a complete Himalayan experience.
highlights: Shikara ride on Dal Lake with sunset views
Visit Mughal Gardens in Srinagar (Nishat & Shalimar)
Drive through Sonmarg and Zoji La Pass
Explore Drass (second coldest inhabited place) and Kargil
Visit Lamayuru Monastery and Moonland landscapes
Experience Magnetic Hill and river confluence (Indus & Zanskar)
Explore Nubra Valley and enjoy camel ride at sand dunes
Visit Pangong Lake, one of the highest saltwater lakes
Cross Khardung La and Chang La high mountain passes
Explore monasteries like Hemis, Thiksey, and Shey

itinerary.title: Arrival at Srinagar Airport and transfer to hotel/Houseboat
itinerary.desc: Upon arrival at the airport, pick up & Drive to the reserved hotel. Later visit local sightseeing’s like Nishat & Shalimar Garden, in the evening enjoy the beautiful sunset at Dal Lake Shikara Ride at Dal Lake. Overnight stay in Hotel / Houseboat

itinerary.title: Early morning departure via Sonmarg and Zoji La Pass
itinerary.desc: After early breakfast leave for Kargil, via Sonamarg & Zojila pass (3,528 m). Since you are driving across Zojila Pass and its route’s uncertainty, you need to reach Sonamarg early in the morning. Reach Drass Village (2nd Coldest Inhabitant place in the World) by lunch time on the way visit War memorial hall & Museum, reach Kargil by evening loc Kargil Hunderman Boader View Point. Distance 200 km approx Check in at hotel in Kargil

itinerary.title: Drive to Leh after breakfast
itinerary.desc: After breakfast departure to Leh on the way visit Mulbekh chamba (Buddha Sculpture on Rock Mountain), Lamayuru (oldest Monastery of Ladakh), Moonland view, Sangam of Sindhu and Zanskar rivers (from view point), Magnetic Hill, Patthar sahib Gurudwara. In evening Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, Market. Distance 220 km approx Overnight at Leh

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: After early breakfast, you will set off for Thiksay monastery. Its looks like Potala palace of Tibet, Enroute visit Druk Pama Karpo (Rancho School) Shey Palace. Hemis Monastery (the largest & richest monasteries in Ladakh). In the evening you can visit Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace (build in 17th century by King Singay Namgyal) after stroll around the market place for some last day souvenir shopping. Distance 40-50 km approx Overnight in Hotel at Leh

itinerary.title: Drive across Khardung La Pass Reach Nubra Valley (Valley of Flowers)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast drive towards to Nubra Valley, driving across Khardong-la (Second Highest Motor able Road in the World alt: 5602Mts/18390Ft). After descending from the pass, Nubra Valley is popularly known as Ldorma or the valley of flowers. It is situated to the north of Ladakh between the Karakoram and Ladakh ranges of the Himalayas. Arrive at Hunder & check in at Hotel/Camps. Later visit Diskit Village & the Sand Dunes where you can enjoy a short camel safari using the double-humped Bactrian camel found here (optional on direct payment). Distance 160 km approx Overnight in Hotel/Camp in Nubra Hunder

itinerary.title: Travel to Pangong Lake via scenic Shyok River route
itinerary.desc: (Note: Route depends on weather conditions. Alternate plan via Leh if required.) After breakfast, leave for Pangong Lake via Shayok. Along the route, enjoy the scenic views of Shayok River & Karakoram Range. This route has few water crossings mainly in the month of June & July, to avoid these you need to leave early from Nubra. Reach Pangong Lake by afternoon. The lake is world highest saltwater lake situated at an elevation of 4,225 m. extending to almost 130 km long, 1/3 of its lies in India and 2/3 in China. NOTE: THIS ROUTE DEPENDS ON WEATHER CONDITIONS. IF ROUTE BLOCK OCCURS REACH BACK TO Leh & STAY OVERNIGH. NEXT DAY Pangong LAKE VISIT WILL BE ONE DAY TRIP. Distance 160 km approx Overnight in Camp/hotel in Pangong

itinerary.title: Return to Leh via Chang La Pass
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, leave for Leh across another one of the highest motorable roads in the world, Chang La Pass at an elevation of 5360 M –. Enroute visiting Shey Palace, Thiksey Monastery. Reach Leh by afternoon/evening, check in at Hotel Leh. Rest & later have a leisure evening in the Leh market. Distance 150 km approx Overnight in Hotel at Leh

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: After Breakfast. Our teams thank you for your patronage and ensure a punctual drop to Airport to catch the flight for your onward Destination

inclusions: Pickup from Srinagar and drop at Leh Airport
exclusions: Adventure activities (rafting, camel safari, paragliding, ATV, etc.)
Extra costs due to weather, delays, or roadblocks
essentialTips: Carry valid government ID (Aadhar / Passport / Voter ID)
Postpaid SIM cards work best in Ladakh region
Pack warm clothing including thermals and jackets
Carry sunscreen, moisturizer, and UV-protection sunglasses
Stay hydrated to avoid altitude sickness
Start early for long travel routes due to weather conditions
